aboutSection.title: About Me
aboutSection.paragraph1: Hello, I'm Bilal Ezzaim, a full-stack developer focused on building and evolving web applications with .NET, C#, React, and modern API technologies. I can also work with Java, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL.
aboutSection.paragraph2: With professional experience approaching 18 months, I have contributed to production systems in banking, healthcare, and education—working on application security, performance, identity integrations, and features from backend to user interface.
